view: PA (frontal; "L" marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation)
technical_quality: Adequate inspiration, no significant rotation, adequate penetration; both costophrenic angles included; mildly under-penetrated upper abdomen.

devices.location: image upper right corner, patient's left

abnormalities.finding: Ill-defined round nodular opacity abutting the right heart border, infrahilar/medial lower zone, ~3-4 cm (labelled mass)
Elevated right hemidiaphragm relative to the left, smooth contour
Mildly prominent hila bilaterally (vascular vs. adenopathy, indeterminate)
Large, dense upper abdomen with bilateral diaphragmatic elevation (body habitus / hepatomegaly not excluded); normal gastric fundus gas on the left

description_zh: PA 正面胸部X光，吸氣尚可，無明顯旋轉，右上角可見「L」側別標記。右肺下野內側、右肺門下方緊鄰右心緣處可見一邊界略模糊之圓形結節狀陰影，直徑約3–4公分，符合標示之肺部腫塊。右側橫膈較左側抬高，雙側肺門略顯突出；心臟大小正常，氣管居中，未見肋膜積液或氣胸。未見任何導管、引流管、心律調節器或手術夾等治療痕跡。
